description: Round 7's own new traceability additions to state.json for FIND-010's closure (BEAD-152/PROP-119/artifact '#PROP-204d' and BEAD-153/PROP-120/artifact '#PROP-307f') are wired INCORRECTLY relative to this exact feature's own, consistently-applied graph convention -- so the new obligations are effectively unreachable by a REQ-204/REQ-307 -> its-own-PROPs traversal, reintroducing (inside state.json itself, one layer below the markdown FIND-010 already fixed) the SAME class of 'this obligation exists but nothing points to it' gap FIND-010 was filed to close. Confirmed convention (checked, not assumed): every OTHER PROP bead under REQ-204 links back to REQ-204's own bead, BEAD-010 -- BEAD-048 (PROP-204a) linkedBeads:['BEAD-010'], BEAD-049 (PROP-204b) linkedBeads:['BEAD-010'], BEAD-050 (PROP-204c) linkedBeads:['BEAD-010'] -- and BEAD-010 itself (type spec-requirement, artifactPath 'specs/behavioral-spec.md#REQ-204') lists all three back in ITS OWN linkedBeads:['BEAD-048','BEAD-049','BEAD-050','BEAD-147','BEAD-151'] (genuinely bidirectional). Likewise every PROP bead under REQ-307 links to REQ-307's own bead, BEAD-138 -- BEAD-139(PROP-307a)/BEAD-140(PROP-307b)/BEAD-141(PROP-307c)/BEAD-142(PROP-307d) each carry linkedBeads:['BEAD-138', <own test-case bead>], and BEAD-138 itself lists all four (plus their test beads) back in its own linkedBeads. This round's two NEW beads break both halves of that convention: BEAD-152 (PROP-204d, the new gas-seed-reclaim obligation, createdInPhase '2c') has linkedBeads:['BEAD-062'] -- BEAD-062 is PROP-303c, an entirely unrelated REQ-303/shelter-cost obligation (FIND-002's fix, nothing to do with the gas-seed reclaim) -- NOT BEAD-010 (REQ-204's own bead). BEAD-153 (PROP-307f, the new runStep-await obligation) has linkedBeads:['BEAD-141'] -- BEAD-141 is the sibling PROP-307c bead (thematically adjacent at best, since both concern per-step failure recording, but still not REQ-307's own bead) -- NOT BEAD-138. Neither BEAD-010 nor BEAD-138 were updated to list BEAD-152/BEAD-153 back in their own linkedBeads arrays either (both still show only their pre-round-7 membership), so the graph edge is missing/wrong in BOTH directions, not merely pointed at a slightly-off sibling. Practical consequence: any tool or fresh reviewer that walks the traceability graph starting from REQ-204's or REQ-307's own bead to enumerate 'which proof obligations govern this requirement' will silently miss PROP-204d and PROP-307f entirely -- the exact 'no PROP obligation anywhere... references reclaim... confirmed by repo-wide grep' failure mode FIND-010 itself described, just one layer deeper (the graph metadata layer, not the prose layer, which this round's markdown edits DID fix correctly). Likely provenance: BEAD-062/BEAD-141 are the bead ids of PROP-303c/PROP-307c respectively -- both are the 'nearest sibling correction' from the SAME correction-writing pass (PROP-303c was FIND-002's own sibling fix in an earlier round; PROP-307c is REQ-307's own pre-existing 9-step failure-matrix obligation) -- consistent with a copy-paste of an adjacent bead id that was never updated to the correct REQ-parent bead.
